title: The Latest Crier for May 08, 2026
items:
Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Campus Wide Worship & Baptism NIGHT

FCA, InterVarsity, ALIVE, & Campus Ministries are hosting a Worship & Baptism Night on May 10 at 8:00 pm in the Chapel! Come for worship, student testimonies, & snacks to follow. If you would like to take this step in your faith & be baptized, reach out to Joe ( brummelj@central.edu ) or Hannah ( laflinh@central.edu ) in the Lower Chapel. We hope to see you there!

Central Student Tradition – Breakfast of Champions SP26 – Monday, May 11, 9:30-10:30PM

The annual student tradition Breakfast of Champions is back Monday, May 11 from 9:30-10:30PM! Enjoy Breakfast favs–Fresh toppings bar–fresh local donuts–all beverage stations will be open! Celebrate the end of the semester with a late-night study break where staff and faculty serve up delicious food, encouragement, and fun!

Doing a World of Good: Log your Tulip Time volunteer hours

If you volunteered during Tulip Time, make sure you log your hours on Central's World of Good website: https://centralcollege.formstack.com/forms/service_hours. It only takes a minute and your hours help to show the economic impact volunteering has. 
Thanks for helping and making a difference!

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The last shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass for the spring 2026 semester will run this Sunday 5/10/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Summer Online Spanish 122 (Beginning Spanish II)

Want to keep building your Spanish skills this summer? Enroll in Spanish 122OL , an engaging online course offered during Central College’s 10-week Summer Session from June 1 through August 7, 2026 . Please contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga with any questions.

Central College Slow Pitch Club Meeting!

The Central College Slowpitch Club will be having its first ever introduction and first meeting on Tuesday May 5th in Van Emmerick (Maytag 2nd floor) from 11:30am-12:30pm! All students who are interested in joining are welcome! We will talk about our direction as a club as well as any opportunities that are possible. If you can't attend but are interested please email luchiv1@central.edu!
